summary.motive: Execute the mathematically and physically near-unstoppable short-yardage quarterback sneak by combining low offensive line pad leverage with dual backfield pushers.
summary.keyDefender: Nose Tackles & Mike Linebacker (Interior Goal-Line Squeeze)
summary.whyItWorks: The Center and Guards create a low-to-high wedge underneath the defensive line, while dual pushers deliver immediate secondary kinetic thrust before the defense can halt forward progress.
summary.failureMode: A false start / offsides penalty or defensive nose tackles timing the snap and cutting the center’s legs from underneath before the pushers engage.

beats.title: 1. Subterranean Pad Level at the Snap
beats.text: Philadelphia’s center and guards fire out with near-zero pad level, wedging their helmets beneath the breastplates of the goal-line nose tackles to create immediate underneath leverage.

beats.title: 2. The Direct A-Gap Insertion
beats.text: The quarterback takes the snap and dives instantly into the low crevice created by the Center, keeping his center of gravity below the defensive line’s knees.

beats.title: 3. Dual-Pusher Kinetic Thrust
beats.text: Both flanking pushers (P1 and P2) latch firmly onto the quarterback’s hips, followed by the fullback, creating an overwhelming 600+ pound wall of forward kinetic force.

beats.title: 4. The Inevitable Conversion
beats.text: Even with linebackers leaping over the pile, the sheer horizontal power of the wedge drives the entire defensive front 2 yards backwards across the goal line for a guaranteed conversion.

relations.tell: Ultra-tight wedge splits along the offensive line with dual pushers aligned directly behind the quarterback’s hips.
